Bom = env["mrp.bom"] boms = Bom.search([("type", "=", "normal"), ("operation_ids", "!=", False)]) if not boms: raise UserError("Nordwire Demo: no BoM with operations found.") pick = datetime.datetime.now().microsecond bom = boms[pick % len(boms)] product = bom.product_tmpl_id.product_variant_id
employees = env["hr.employee"].search([("company_id", "=", env.company.id)]) employee = employees[pick % len(employees)] if employees else env["hr.employee"]
mo = env["mrp.production"].create({ "product_id": product.id, "product_qty": 1.0, "bom_id": bom.id, "company_id": env.company.id, }) mo.action_confirm()
for wo in mo.workorder_ids: wo.workcenter_id.write({"working_state": "normal"}) wo.button_start() if employee: wo.start_employee(employee.id) for qc in wo.check_ids.filtered(lambda c: c.quality_state == "none"): qc.do_pass() wo.button_finish() if employee: wo.stop_employee(employee.ids)
mo.write({"qty_producing": mo.product_qty}) mo.button_mark_done() _logger.info("Nordwire Demo: generated %s (%s) worked by %s", mo.name, product.display_name, employee.name if employee else "no employee")
